These plans come from T12's simulation, which detected every class — potholes included — at Model B's recall (certified α 0.5 at threshold 0.117: linear crack 0.36, alligator 0.64, pothole 0.53). Under D082 a survey takes potholes from Model P; P's recall is not used here. False alarms are not simulated. One synthetic network, seed 0, fixed in advance.
